page.title: Learn
page.subtitle: Explore guides on AI, tooling, and development

intro-ia-generative.title: Introduction to Generative AI
intro-ia-generative.description: Understand generative AI and LLMs: key concepts (tokens, context window, temperature), how transformers work, and an introduction to embeddings and RAG.

vite-tooling.title: Vite: the modern build tool
vite-tooling.description: Discover Vite, its advantages over Webpack, and how to configure a React/TypeScript project with env variables and path aliases.

pnpm-workspaces.title: Monorepo with pnpm workspaces
pnpm-workspaces.description: Structure and manage a JavaScript/TypeScript monorepo with pnpm workspaces, workspace protocol, changesets and shared scripts.

react-micro-frontends.title: Micro-frontends with React and single-spa
react-micro-frontends.description: Architect an application into independent micro-frontends with single-spa, import maps, React parcels and shared dependencies.

prompt-engineering.title: Prompt Engineering
prompt-engineering.description: Master prompt engineering with zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, role prompting, system prompts and structured output.

llm-api-patterns.title: LLM API Patterns
llm-api-patterns.description: Build robust LLM integrations: streaming responses, error handling, rate limiting, cost management and parallel requests.

rag-fundamentals.title: RAG Fundamentals
rag-fundamentals.description: Connect LLMs to your own data with Retrieval-Augmented Generation: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies and a full TypeScript pipeline.

llm-agents.title: LLM Agents
llm-agents.description: Design autonomous LLM systems: function calling, the ReAct pattern, agent loops in TypeScript, and production failure modes.

llm-production.title: LLMs in Production
llm-production.description: Make LLM integrations production-ready: observability, prompt injection defence, cost optimisation, resilience patterns and model selection.

copilot-intro.title: Getting started with GitHub Copilot
copilot-intro.description: Understand the different modes of GitHub Copilot (inline, chat, agent), how it integrates into your workflow, and why it fundamentally changes the way you write code.

copilot-agents-md-setup.title: Configuring AGENTS.md
copilot-agents-md-setup.description: Understand the role of AGENTS.md, set up the symlink to .github/copilot-instructions.md, and structure the file to give Copilot the right context for your project.

copilot-agents-md-best-practices.title: Best practices for AGENTS.md
copilot-agents-md-best-practices.description: Write actionable rules with ✅/❌ examples, structure sections effectively, calibrate the level of detail, and avoid vague rules that have no real impact on agent behaviour.

copilot-skills.title: Creating and using Skills
copilot-skills.description: Understand what a Copilot Skill is, how to create one, when skills are a better fit than an instruction in AGENTS.md, and how to organise them in your project.

copilot-mcp.title: MCP (Model Context Protocol)
copilot-mcp.description: Discover the Model Context Protocol: how it works, concrete use cases, configuring it in Copilot, and how it compares to skills so you can pick the right tool.

copilot-custom-agents.title: Custom Agents
copilot-custom-agents.description: Design and build Custom Agents: when a dedicated agent is a better fit than an AGENTS.md instruction, how to structure an agent, and real-world examples.

seo.description: Technical guides on AI, tooling and front-end architecture.

ia-llm-fundamentals.title: AI & LLM Fundamentals
ia-llm-fundamentals.description: The essentials to understand generative AI: how LLMs work, tokens, context window, and mastering prompt engineering

ia-llm-applied.title: Building with LLMs
ia-llm-applied.description: Concrete patterns for building with LLM APIs: robust integrations, RAG on your own data, autonomous agents and production deployment

tooling-essentials.title: Modern Tooling
tooling-essentials.description: Master the essential tools of a modern JavaScript project: fast builds with Vite and monorepo management with pnpm workspaces

frontend-architecture.title: Front-end Architecture
frontend-architecture.description: Design scalable front-end systems using micro-frontend patterns with React and single-spa

copilot-with-ai-agents.title: Developing with Copilot & AI Agents
copilot-with-ai-agents.description: Configure GitHub Copilot effectively, master AGENTS.md, create skills and custom agents, and leverage MCPs to automate your development workflow
